title: Social Development
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind social development and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply social development in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using social development to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what social development means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying social development in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how social development works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use social development in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to social development. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
